options.name: core
options.description: The operator listener, state folder, operator bootstrap, keys and infrastructure target.

settings.name: port
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_PORT: Port of the operator listener.

settings.name: bind
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_BIND: Address of the operator listener (an IP address or localhost).

settings.name: dataRoot
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_DATA_ROOT: The state folder (defaults to data beside the control plane).

settings.name: allowedHosts
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_ALLOWED_HOSTS: Host names the operator listener answers (comma-separated).

settings.name: secureCookie
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_SECURE_COOKIE: Whether operator session cookies are Secure.

settings.name: trustedProxy
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_TRUSTED_PROXY: Whether the operator listener sits behind a trusted proxy (x-forwarded-for is then the client).

settings.name: operatorEmail
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_OPERATOR_EMAIL: Email of the first operator, created on a fresh start.

settings.name: operatorPassword
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD_FILE: Password of the first operator (a mounted secret file; PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD may hold it instead, never both).

settings.name: masterKey
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_MASTER_KEY_FILE: The 32-byte master key of the operator identity store (a mounted secret file; defaults to master.key in the state folder).

settings.name: signingKeyRef
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_SIGNING_KEY_REF: The platform image signing key reference (the generated platform key when unset).

settings.name: signingKey
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_SIGNING_KEY_FILE: The platform signing key (a mounted secret file; the key store in the state folder when unset).

settings.name: infraTarget
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_INFRA_TARGET: local (this host's Docker and kind), none, or hosted (registered clusters over the mesh).

settings.name: kubeconfig
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_KUBECONFIG_FILE: The kubeconfig of the hosted clusters (a mounted secret file).

settings.name: agentChannelUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AGENT_CHANNEL_URL: Public URL of the agent channel that hive install bundles point at.

settings.name: desktopTenantPlaneUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_DESKTOP_TENANT_PLANE_URL: Where the desktop app finds the tenant plane (derived from the tenant plane settings when unset).

options.name: internalApi
options.description: The internal API the platform edge calls (off unless enabled).

settings.name: port
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_INTERNAL_PORT: Port of the internal API listener.

settings.name: bind
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_ADMIN_INTERNAL_BIND: Address of the internal API listener (an IP address or localhost).

settings.name: secret
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_INTERNAL_API_SECRET_FILE: The shared secret the edge authenticates with (a mounted secret file).

options.name: releases
options.description: The release catalogue: signed release descriptors read from an OCI registry and imported on a poll.

settings.name: registry
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RELEASE_REGISTRY: The registry (https; http only for a loopback registry).

settings.name: namespace
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RELEASE_NAMESPACE: The registry namespace of the release repositories.

settings.name: trustDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RELEASE_TRUST_DIR: Folder of trusted release public keys (defaults to the shipped release-keys).

settings.name: pollSeconds
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RELEASE_POLL_SECONDS: Seconds between two catalogue refreshes (0 turns the poll off).

settings.name: credential
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RELEASE_CREDENTIAL_FILE: The registry read credential, JSON with username and token (a mounted secret file).

options.name: tenantPlane
options.description: The tenant plane co-hosted with the operator listener (on when port and baseDomain are set).

settings.name: port
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_PORT: Port of the tenant listener.

settings.name: baseDomain
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_BASE_DOMAIN: Tenants are served at <tenant>.<baseDomain>.

settings.name: bind
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_BIND: Address of the tenant listener.

settings.name: externalScheme
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_EXTERNAL_SCHEME: Scheme browsers use for tenant origins.

settings.name: externalPort
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_EXTERNAL_PORT: Port browsers use for tenant origins, when not the scheme default.

settings.name: trustedProxy
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_TRUSTED_PROXY: Whether the tenant listener sits behind a trusted proxy.

settings.name: secretTtlHours
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_SECRET_TTL_HOURS: Lifetime of issued tenant secrets, in hours.

settings.name: healthProbeMs
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_HEALTH_PROBE_MS: Interval of environment health probes, in milliseconds.

settings.name: healthProbeTimeoutMs
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TENANT_ADMIN_HEALTH_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS: Timeout of one environment health probe, in milliseconds.

roles.name: operator.full
roles.description: A platform operator who may change the platform (Owner grant on the control-plane realm).

roles.name: operator.read-only
roles.description: A platform operator who may only observe (Viewer grant, or no Owner grant).
